Container.Name: torbox-client
Container.Overview: Use TorBox as a download client for Sonarr and Radarr. Emulates qBittorrent: your *arr apps send releases here, this container downloads them via TorBox and pulls the finished files to your downloads share so Sonarr/Radarr import them normally. Works like rdt-client but for TorBox.
Container.Description: Use TorBox as a download client for Sonarr/Radarr. Add it in each *arr app under Settings -> Download Clients as a qBittorrent client (Host = this container/host IP, Port = 8080, Username/Password = your QBIT_USER/QBIT_PASS). Set a category such as tv-sonarr / radarr. IMPORTANT: mount the SAME downloads share here as you mount in Sonarr/Radarr, at the same path, so imports (hardlinks) work.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port Sonarr/Radarr connect to (the emulated qBittorrent API).

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: MUST be the same downloads share (at the same path) that Sonarr/Radarr use, so imports work.

Config.Name: TORBOX_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your TorBox API key from https://torbox.app/settings

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership (Unraid default: 100 = users).

Config.Name: SAVE_PATH
Config.Description: Only set this if Sonarr/Radarr see the downloads at a DIFFERENT internal path than this container (e.g. /data/downloads). Otherwise leave blank.

Config.Name: MAX_PARALLEL_DOWNLOADS
Config.Description: Concurrent file downloads from the TorBox CDN.

Config.Name: MAX_PARALLEL_TORRENTS
Config.Description: Torrents pulled locally at the same time (0 = unlimited).

Config.Name: MAX_DOWNLOAD_SPEED
Config.Description: Aggregate download speed cap in MiB/s across all files (0 = unlimited).

Config.Name: TORBOX_CLEANUP_HOURS
Config.Description: Delete the TorBox cloud copy this long after the local download completes (0 = never). Frees your TorBox active-torrent slots; local files are kept.
